route.name: Marina Capo d'Orlando - Gioioa Marea
route.description:
Today's tour from Capo d'Orlando is a perfect blend of cycling, history and coastal charm. You'll follow Sicily's historic coastal road to the medieval town of Brolo, explore its castle and then continue on to Gioiosa Marea, where you can enjoy a refreshing granita with views of the Aeolian Islands. Along the way, you'll discover centuries-old watchtowers and stop at hidden beaches for a swim!
Feeling adventurous? Extend the route to Capo Calavà, where the road winds dramatically through the cliffs above the turquoise sea (+10 km/+6.2 miles).
